say:4:1423104003:1.text: According to Hyla, most of the craftsmen are loafing around, and the few who listen to her can hardly keep things running.
say:4:1423104003:1.source_cn: 生产线那边，海拉告诉我，大多数工匠都在怠工，少数听她话...

say:5:1423104004:1.text: There's a group of veterans who only take orders from Ironbeard, but he's thinking about leaving the village for good.
say:5:1423104004:1.source_cn: 还有一批资历深的工匠现在只听铁须的话，他们都是技术上的...

say:6:1423104005:1.text: At this rate, all of the craftsmen in the village will soon be gone, leaving just us old timers behind...
say:6:1423104005:1.source_cn: 照这样下去，除了我们这些老顽固，村里的工匠很快就要走空了……

say:7:1423104006:0.text: When the time comes, we can forget about researching arcane steel or working with Sal'thorin!
say:7:1423104006:0.source_cn: 更别提研究魔钢和跟萨洛克兰合作这种事了！

choice_prompt:8:1423104006.text: When the time comes, we can forget about researching arcane steel or working with Sal'thorin!

say:9:1423104007:0.text: The situation in the mine is the worst, and Hyla's doing her best to maintain order at Bleak Passage...

choice:10:0:1.male: I'll go give her a hand.
choice:10:0:1.female: I'll go give her a hand.

choice:8:0:1.male: Anything I can do to help?
choice:8:0:1.female: Anything I can do to help?

say:0:1423105001:0.source_cn: 这些工匠……为什么不进矿洞？完全没有人在干活的样子。

choice_prompt:2:1423107001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm sorry you have to see this mess.

say:3:1423107002:0.text: What can I say? It's a triple blow to us—the echorite depletion, Eldric's scheme getting exposed, and the pressure from the Lightbearers...
say:3:1423107002:0.source_cn: 就是你看到的这样，深岩晶出事，弗林的阴谋败露，耀光那边...
say:3:1423107002:0.male: What can I say? It's a triple blow to us—the echorite depletion, Eldric's scheme getting exposed, and the pressure from the Lightbearers...
say:3:1423107002:0.female: What can I say? It's a triple blow to us—the echorite depletion, Eldric's scheme getting exposed, and the pressure from the Lightbearers...

say:4:1423107003:0.text: After going through all of this, many craftsmen felt disheartened and decided to join Ironbeard's side...
say:4:1423107003:0.source_cn: 经历过这些后，人心彻底散了，许多人都去了铁须那边……

say:5:1423107004:0.text: There aren't many who stay here, but even so, I can barely get them to follow my orders.
say:5:1423107004:0.source_cn: 我手下只剩下几个人了，就这几个人，我都指挥不动他们。

say:6:1423107005:0.text: It's long past the time to head into the mine, but nobody's showing up...
say:6:1423107005:0.source_cn: 早就到了该下矿的时间，这些人却都不愿意过来……

say:7:1423107006:0.text: And the only ones who did come were completely wasted!
say:7:1423107006:0.source_cn: 来了的也是醉醺醺的，站都站不起来，说等人齐了他才开工！

say:8:1423107007:0.text: If we can't keep the supply of celestrites steady, the arcane steel research will take the hit... I'm really at my wits' end this time.
say:8:1423107007:0.source_cn: 矿洞这边的矿石供应不上，魔钢研究的原料就会出问题……真...

choice_prompt:9:1423107007.text: If we can't keep the supply of celestrites steady, the arcane steel research will take the hit... I'm really at my wits' end this time.
choice_prompt:9:1423107007.source_cn: 矿洞这边的矿石供应不上，魔钢研究的原料就会出问题……真是让我头疼。

say:10:1423107008:0.text: That's what I figured too. Could you help me with that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:10:1423107008:0.female: That's what I figured too. Could you help me with that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice:9:0:1.text: Gather those who can work first.
choice:9:0:1.male: Gather those who can work first.
choice:9:0:1.female: Gather those who can work first.

say:2:1423108001:0.text: Everyone's here now. No more getting out of work this time.
say:2:1423108001:0.source_cn: 这下人都齐了，可以开始下矿干活了吧。

say:3:1423108002:0.source_cn: 这个……还真被你找齐了……这……

say:4:1423108003:0.text: It's not that we're lazy! There are wolves in the mine, for heaven's sake!
say:4:1423108003:0.source_cn: 不是俺们不想干活！是因为矿洞里有野狼！

say:6:1423108005:0.text: Hyla, you know the mine hasn't had any guards these days, right? That's why the wild beasts have no trouble getting in.
say:6:1423108005:0.source_cn: 海拉你也知道嘛，现在矿洞人手不足，根本没有守备的人，这...

say:7:1423108006:0.text: We'd be brave enough to go in if there were more of us... But now? Mining with this pathetic group? I'd rather stay safe and alive!
say:7:1423108006:0.source_cn: 以前人多还敢壮着胆子进去，现在就剩俺们几个人……别丢了...

say:8:1423108007:0.text: You'll go in once the wolves are cleared out, right?
say:8:1423108007:0.source_cn: 把野狼清理掉你们就肯下矿干活了吧。

say:0:1423109001:0.text: There aren't that many wolves here. That craftsman was just exaggerating.
say:0:1423109001:0.source_cn: 野狼的数量根本没有工匠们说的那么多。
say:0:1423109001:0.male: There aren't that many wolves here. That craftsman was just exaggerating.
say:0:1423109001:0.female: There aren't that many wolves here. That craftsman was just exaggerating.

say:2:1423110001:0.text: The mine's safe now. Guess you can finally go in and start working, huh?
say:2:1423110001:0.source_cn: 矿洞里现在安全了，可以下矿干活了吧？

say:4:1423110003:0.text: Let me be honest with you, Hyla!

say:5:1423110004:0.text: The truth is, we've considered joining Ironbeard for some time! We're just sticking around a little longer to weigh our options.
say:5:1423110004:0.source_cn: 其实俺们几个早就想去铁须那边了……只不过想先观察观察情况。

say:6:1423110005:0.text: More and more of our peers are leaving. We have to think about our future, you know?
say:6:1423110005:0.source_cn: 眼看这边的人越来越少，不成气候，铁须那边的人越来越多，...

say:7:1423110006:0.text: Just say it—you want to quit, don't you?
say:7:1423110006:0.source_cn: 直接点说，你们不想干了？

say:8:1423110007:0.text: I wish I could do this more pleasantly, but you're right.
say:8:1423110007:0.source_cn: 俺不想说这么直接……可话说得难听点，就是这个意思。

choice_prompt:9:1423110007.text: I wish I could do this more pleasantly, but you're right.
choice_prompt:9:1423110007.source_cn: 俺不想说这么直接……可话说得难听点，就是这个意思。

say:10:1423110008:0.text: No, we think it's a good idea.

say:11:1423110009:0.text: But our support alone won't make a difference!

say:12:1423110010:0.text: All the skilled folks are working for Ironbeard now! We only do grunt work here.
say:12:1423110010:0.source_cn: 村里的技术好手都在铁须那边，俺们只能干点体力活。

say:13:1423110011:0.text: Everyone would stay if the arcane steel technology were ready by now!
say:13:1423110011:0.source_cn: 要是这魔钢现在就能研究出来，那大伙自然都不会走了！

say:14:1423110016:0.text: Looks like the biggest issue lies with Ironbeard.
say:14:1423110016:0.source_cn: 看来最大的问题还是在铁须那边……

say:15:1423110017:0.text: You know what Ironbeard's up to while we're stuck here? He's busy throwing a farewell feast for his scouts!
say:15:1423110017:0.source_cn: 就瞧现在，咱这边冷冷清清的，几个人干所有的活，铁须那边...

say:16:1423110018:0.text: Who'd want to stay here when there are delicious treats and a fun party waiting somewhere else?
say:16:1423110018:0.source_cn: 比起待在这，俺们肯定更想去宴会吃点喝点，凑凑热闹啊！

say:18:1423110020:0.text: I heard he's sending some scouts to survey a vein in a mountain, and he'll be sending more to other places as well.
say:18:1423110020:0.source_cn: 好像是要派一批工匠去考察一处矿山的矿脉，后面还要派好几...

choice_prompt:19:1423110020.text: I heard he's sending some scouts to survey a vein in a mountain, and he'll be sending more to other places as well.
choice_prompt:19:1423110020.source_cn: 好像是要派一批工匠去考察一处矿山的矿脉，后面还要派好几批人去不同地方考察呢。

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 村里的人力会短缺得更严重

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 村里的工匠会大量流失

say:22:1423110012:0.text: Of course, I want restore my village its former glory!

say:23:1423110013:0.text: But we can't pull it off with so few of us.
say:23:1423110013:0.source_cn: 可这不是俺们几个人能办到的事。

say:24:1423110014:0.text: All this talk about arcane steel, but where's the proof? When's it actually happening?
say:24:1423110014:0.source_cn: 像你们说的要研究魔钢拯救村子，这不是还没影吗？谁知道什...

say:25:1423110015:0.text: The best craftsmen are all with Ironbeard. What if the research takes years, or even decades, to complete? Are we supposed to just sit around and wait?
say:25:1423110015:0.source_cn: 最好的工匠都在铁须那边，咱们这边就剩这么几个人，要是得...

say:0:1423111001:0.text: Let's crash his party right now.
say:0:1423111001:0.source_cn: 得抓紧时间去欢送宴现场看看。
say:0:1423111001:0.male: Let's crash his party right now.
say:0:1423111001:0.female: Let's crash his party right now.

say:0:1423112001:0.text: I saw Ironbeard! He and the others are over there!
say:0:1423112001:0.source_cn: 看到铁须了，他们在那儿！

say:2:1423114002:0.text: It's obvious, isn't it? What good is it to stay here?
say:2:1423114002:0.source_cn: 当然了，不走还待在这里干什么？

say:3:1423114003:1.text: Instead of waiting for the Lightbearers to split us up and send us to some far-flung places, I'd rather we all go to a new place and start fresh!
say:3:1423114003:1.source_cn: 比起村子被耀光彻底抛弃，伙计们被打散送到不知名的矿山，...

say:4:1423114004:1.text: I already told you, if we work with Sal'thorin and enchant the celestrites, we could create something even better than echorites.
say:4:1423114004:1.source_cn: 我已经跟你说过，如果能与萨洛克兰合作，研究将魔力注入矿...

say:5:1423114005:1.text: It's the best way to save our village, and yet here you are, sending our craftsmen away!
say:5:1423114005:1.source_cn: 这才是拯救村子最好的方式，可你不仅无动于衷，现在还要让...

say:6:1423114006:1.text: Listen to yourself! You're no different from Eldric!
say:6:1423114006:1.source_cn: 你说的这些话跟弗林之前的话术有什么差别？

say:7:1423114007:1.text: He talked us into working with those underground pointy ears, but what happened in the end? The echorites turned out to be dragon eggshells, and they were gone just like that!
say:7:1423114007:1.source_cn: 什么跟地底合作才能得到最好的矿石，让我们矮人出人出力帮...

say:8:1423114008:1.text: Had it not been for him, our village wouldn't be in this sorry state!
say:8:1423114008:1.source_cn: 如果不是他联合地底的尖耳朵搞这些阴谋诡计，深岩村根本不...

say:9:1423114009:1.text: But our village wouldn't have prospered either without echorites.
say:9:1423114009:1.source_cn: 没有深岩晶，深岩村也不会有之前的繁荣。

say:10:1423114010:1.text: Are you defending Eldric? I knew it! You two are in cahoots!
say:10:1423114010:1.source_cn: 什么意思？你在帮弗林说话？你们果然是一伙的！

say:11:1423114011:1.text: I'm just stating the facts. We owe our previous success to both the echorites and the production line we set up.
say:11:1423114011:1.source_cn: 我只是在陈述事实，深岩村的繁荣离不开深岩晶，也离不开我...

say:12:1423114012:1.text: Are you seriously going to throw away all our hard work and start over?
say:12:1423114012:1.source_cn: 你真的要彻底舍弃这些心血，从头开始吗？

say:13:1423114013:1.text: In any case, I can no longer trust those pointy ears.
say:13:1423114013:1.source_cn: 总之，我不可能再信任那些地底的尖耳朵和合作这种话术了。

choice_prompt:14:1423114013.text: In any case, I can no longer trust those pointy ears.
choice_prompt:14:1423114013.source_cn: 总之，我不可能再信任那些地底的尖耳朵和合作这种话术了。

say:16:1423114015:1.text: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?
say:16:1423114015:1.male: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?
say:16:1423114015:1.female: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?

say:17:1423114016:1.text: After all, he was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.
say:17:1423114016:1.male: After all, he was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.
say:17:1423114016:1.female: After all, she was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.

say:18:1423114017:1.text: Let him show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?
say:18:1423114017:1.male: Let him show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?
say:18:1423114017:1.female: Let her show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?

say:19:1423114018:1.text: This incredible technology could help us produce something even better than echorites!
say:19:1423114018:1.source_cn: 你还没机会见识吧，有可能研制出超越深岩晶的矿石的伟大技术！

say:20:1423114019:1.text: Um... I have to think about it.

say:21:1423114020:1.text: Alright, I'll take a look at this so-called technology, just to see if you're trying to bluff us.
say:21:1423114020:1.source_cn: 为了判断你们说的究竟是不是谎话，我可以跟你们去看看那所...

say:22:1423114021:1.text: Well, can your scouts wait for a bit before they go?
say:22:1423114021:1.source_cn: 那你的先遣队成员们，不用着急动身了吧？

say:28:1423114024:1.text: Only if what you show me is enough to change my mind.
say:28:1423114024:1.source_cn: 前提是你们让我看到的东西真的能让我回心转意。

say:29:1423114025:1.text: Let's pick a date. We'll need some time to prepare.
say:29:1423114025:1.source_cn: 那我们约个时间吧。我们还得……准备准备。

say:30:1423114026:1.text: I'll say this upfront—if I don't see something convincing soon, I won't be able to stop these youngsters from leaving.
say:30:1423114026:1.source_cn: 如果不能尽快见到能说服我的技术，我可拦不住这些年轻人。

say:0:1423115001:0.text: Phew... that worked. Let's find Zanie and fill her in.
say:0:1423115001:0.source_cn: 呼……总算把人劝下了，我们去找祖娅说明情况吧。

say:3:1423116002:1.text: What's wrong? You guys look pretty grim.
say:3:1423116002:1.source_cn: 怎么啦？怎么一脸沉重的样子？

choice_prompt:4:1423116002.text: What's wrong? You guys look pretty grim.
choice_prompt:4:1423116002.source_cn: 怎么啦？怎么一脸沉重的样子？

say:5:1423116003:1.text: Hmm... So, they're still around, right?
say:5:1423116003:1.source_cn: 唔……总之他们现在还没走对吧！

say:6:1423116004:1.text: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!
say:6:1423116004:1.male: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!
say:6:1423116004:1.female: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!

choice_prompt:7:1423116004.text: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!
choice_prompt:7:1423116004.source_cn: 要对<style=stress><player_name></style>的魔力和矮人的好胜心有信心啊！
choice_prompt:7:1423116004.male: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!
choice_prompt:7:1423116004.female: Let's have faith in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s magic and the dwarves' competitive spirit!

say:8:1423116005:1.text: I'm sure Ironbeard would be interested in crafting weapons superior to those from Eldric's era. We just need to make him see that arcane steel is the key to achieving that.
say:8:1423116005:1.source_cn: 要让铁须意识到，要达到甚至超越弗林时代的深岩村武器品质...

say:9:1423116006:1.text: Anyway, we're doing way better than I thought we would! Let's keep this momentum going!
say:9:1423116006:1.source_cn: 总之现在的进展已经超出我的预料了，我们继续加油吧！
